name: now-note
title: Now note
description: A short, dated note of what someone is up to right now, with the availability as a badge in words. It adds how long ago it was updated and, past a stale-after limit, says plainly that it may be out of date. Quiet is a dated line; warm is a sticky note in the hand; playful is a café chalkboard in a wooden frame.

budget.reason: Decision 0005: 12 KB of behaviour plus 8 KB for each of three skins. Today 5921 bytes: element 3.0 KB, pure core 2.2 KB, skins quiet 0.1 KB, warm 0.4 KB, playful 0.2 KB. The state is the badge component.
